reason: A DSH plugin whose primary purpose is providing a feature-rich terminal user interface for agent conversations, session controls, status visualization, context metrics, and connected tool workflows.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 智能体会话提供交互式终端界面，包含流式消息、状态与上下文指标、会话管理及工具交互功能。
summaries.en: An interactive terminal interface for DSH agent sessions with streaming messages, status and context metrics, session management, and tool interactions.

capabilities: Provides an interactive terminal user interface for DSH sessions
Displays streaming model output, agent status, context usage, token metrics, and session information
Supports session resume, rewind or fork, model selection, compaction, and export workflows
Handles file references, image attachments, clipboard input, and terminal-based editing
Connects to existing DSH services, agent presets, skills, MCP servers, subagents, and approval flows
Can expose commands and tool interactions that may access configured files, models, or external services
